Purpose: This rmd is dedicated towards species richness analysis
- Species richness, shannon, and simpson diversity metrics for each stream/depth combination
- Supporting box plots
- Mixed Effects models 
    - test whether richness varies with temperature nonlinearly
    - test whether that temperature relationship differs by depth
    - visualize fitted temperature richness curves with uncertainty


Necessary Environment Objects
- bugs: ISP main markdown

Environment Objects Created
- diversity_df
- diversity_long
- richness_long

# Set Up
```{r}
library(vegan)
library(hillR)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest) 
library(emmeans)
```


```{r}
# Calculate diversity for each station-depth community profile
diversity_df <- bugs %>%
  select(sample_id, stream, depth, tempDepth) %>%
  mutate(
    richness = vegan::specnumber(comm),
    shannon = vegan::diversity(comm, index = "shannon"),
    simpson = vegan::diversity(comm, index = "simpson")
  )

# Put the metrics into a format convenient for plotting
diversity_long <- diversity_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(richness, shannon, simpson),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "diversity_value"
  )

depth_levels <- levels(droplevels(bugs$depth))

metric_labels <- c(
  richness = "Species Richness",
  shannon = "Shannon Diversity",
  simpson = "Simpson Diversity (1 - D)"
)

# Create one plot per metric per depth
diversity_plots <- lapply(names(metric_labels), function(metric_name) {
  plots_at_depth <- lapply(depth_levels, function(d) {
    plot_data <- diversity_long %>%
      filter(
        metric == metric_name,
        as.character(depth) == as.character(d)
      )

    ggplot(
      plot_data,
      aes(x = stream, y = diversity_value, fill = stream)
      ) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          metric_labels[[metric_name]],
          "- Depth:",
          depth_labels[[as.character(d)]]
        ),
        x = "Stream",
       y = metric_labels[[metric_name]]
          ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
            )
  })

  names(plots_at_depth) <- as.character(depth_levels)
  plots_at_depth
})

names(diversity_plots) <- names(metric_labels)

diversity_plots$richness[["surber"]]
diversity_plots$richness[["25"]]
diversity_plots$richness[["50"]]

diversity_plots$shannon[["surber"]]
diversity_plots$shannon[["25"]]
diversity_plots$shannon[["50"]]

diversity_plots$simpson[["surber"]]
diversity_plots$simpson[["25"]]
diversity_plots$simpson[["50"]]
```

```{r}
stream_levels <- c("is-11", "is-10", "is-7", "is-1", "is-5", "is-6", "is-8")
stream_spacing <- 1.4  # Increase this for more space between streams

diversity_plots_3 <- lapply(names(metric_labels), function(metric_name) {
  plot_data <- diversity_long %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    mutate(
      stream = factor(stream, levels = stream_levels),
      stream_x = as.numeric(stream) * stream_spacing,
      depth = factor(
        as.character(depth),
        levels = c("surber", "25", "50")
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = stream_x, y = diversity_value, fill = depth)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(group = interaction(stream, depth)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.7,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.12,
        dodge.width = 0.8
      ),
      alpha = 0.7,
      size = 2
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(stream_levels) * stream_spacing,
      labels = stream_levels
    ) +
    scale_fill_discrete(
      name = "Depth",
      labels = c(
        "surber" = "Surface (0 cm)",
        "25" = "25 cm",
        "50" = "50 cm"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(metric_labels[[metric_name]], "Across Stream and Depth"),
      x = "Stream",
      y = metric_labels[[metric_name]]
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
      aspect.ratio = 0.5,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
    )
})

names(diversity_plots_3) <- names(metric_labels)

diversity_plots_3$richness
diversity_plots_3$shannon
diversity_plots_3$simpson
```

### New method

```{r}
# Build Data Frame
richness_model_dat <- richness_long %>%
  group_by(stream, depth) %>%
  mutate(temp_pair = mean(tempDepth, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    temp_c = temp_pair - mean(temp_pair, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Fit Models
### linear
m_int <- lmer(
  richness ~ temp_c * depth + (1 | stream) + (1 | stream:depth),
  data = richness_model_dat,
  REML = FALSE
)

### quadratic
m_quad <- lmer(
  richness ~ temp_c * depth + I(temp_c^2) +
    (1 | stream) + (1 | stream:depth), # 1 means intercepts can vary but not slopes 
  data = richness_model_dat,           # (1 | stream) streams have their own baseline richness
  REML = FALSE                        # (1 | stream:depth) depths within streams have their own 
)                                          # baseline too 
summary(m_quad)

### quadratic with no interaction
m_quad_no_interaction <- lmer(
  richness ~ temp_c + depth + I(temp_c^2) +
    (1 | stream) + (1 | stream:depth),
  data = richness_model_dat,
  REML = FALSE
)

# Compare Models
anova(m_int, m_quad)

anova(m_quad_no_interaction, m_quad)
```

### Visualizations

```{r}
# Predict across the observed centered-temperature range at each depth
pred <- emmeans(
  m_quad,
  ~ depth | temp_c,
  at = list(
    temp_c = seq(
      min(richness_model_dat$temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(richness_model_dat$temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 100))) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Convert centered temperature back to the original temperature scale
temp_center <- mean(richness_model_dat$temp_pair, na.rm = TRUE)
pred$temp_pair <- pred$temp_c + temp_center

# Plot 
ggplot(pred, aes(x = temp_pair, y = emmean, color = depth, fill = depth)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Temperature",
    y = "Predicted mean species richness",
    color = "Depth",
    fill = "Depth",
    title = "Predicted Mean Species Richness Across Observed Temperatures by Depth"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
